caption: The video captures a close-up of a wet, unlit clear glass bulb suspended from a black threaded socket and a vertical hanging wire. The bulb hangs against an out-of-focus background of green foliage punctuated by soft bokeh circles. A diagonal cable studded with bead-like water droplets cuts across the upper-right corner of the frame. Faint vertical rain streaks appear and fade at shifting positions behind the bulb throughout the clip. The hanging bulb sways very slightly, tilting in small oscillations while staying roughly centered. Droplets clinging to the glass surface and the cable shift and merge subtly as the rain continues. The blurred green backdrop stays soft and largely steady under overcast light. The framing remains largely fixed, so the visible motion is confined to the gentle sway of the bulb and the falling rain.
